verdicts.quote: "OAuth 2.0 is a protocol that lets your app request authorization to read or modify data in a user's monday account."
verdicts.reason: Monday exposes a public OAuth flow for apps; for a multi-tenant agent toolkit this is the primary method even though personal API tokens also exist. ([developer.monday.com](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/oauth))

verdicts.quote: "Each app is reviewed to help ensure compliance with our marketplace guidelines."
verdicts.reason: Devs can install/share apps themselves, but public marketplace distribution requires submitting for approval, i.e., app review. ([developer.monday.com](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/install-and-share-your-apps))

verdicts.quote: "It supports operations boards, items, column values, users, workspaces, and more."
verdicts.reason: Docs show many first‑class objects and CRUD across the product, indicating broad API coverage. ([developer.monday.com](https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/basics))
Monday documents and hosts its own MCP server, confirming an official MCP integration. ([developer.monday.com](https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/integrate-with-monday-mcp))

verdicts.quote: "You can install the app on your own account for testing"
verdicts.reason: Self‑serve creds and docs make it buildable today; caveat is that broader distribution (marketplace/public OAuth) requires app review. ([developer.monday.com](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/install-and-share-your-apps))
